ar_ork_wall.blurb: Ork Wall is a small sport crag on the Stack Rock formation, in the Richland Creek area of north-central Arkansas. It holds five bolted lines: three at 5.10, one at 5.11 and one at 5.12, so it mainly suits climbers working through the 5.10 range. The wall catches plenty of sun. It is one of the first walls you meet if you walk the loop trail around the rock counterclockwise. Stack Rock as a whole is a remote, backcountry crag that curves around in a crown-like shape, loose rock is not unusual there, and the hike in runs longer than at most Arkansas crags.

ar_poison_ivy_wall.blurb: Poison Ivy Wall is a short wall on The Throne, the hill in the valley at Sam's Throne in north-central Arkansas. It is a slab-and-corner system, steep in places, found just to the right where the trail forks on the way in. Five lines are climbed here: three trad routes from 5.6 to 5.8 and two bolted lines at 5.10 and 5.11. The 5.7+ trad line is the most popular and best rated on the wall. The Throne overall gets a mix of sun and shade, has plenty of easier lines with simple access to the top for toprope, and makes a good stop for newer leaders. The rock is described as generally great.

ar_green_room.blurb: Green Room is a small bouldering area on the west side of Horseshoe Canyon Ranch in north-central Arkansas, close to the much larger Idaho Boulders. The setting is a pit-like cave formed where boulders lean against one another. Five problems are climbed here, running from V1 up to V5, with a pair at V3, so there is a bit for most levels. The best-rated line is a V3 traverse. There is no well-defined trail in.
